links: Futur and Conditionnel share the stem stopper-. Learn one and you have both.
The Imparfait stem stopp- is the nous form of the Présent (stoppons) with -ons removed.
The Subjonctif stem stopp- is the ils form of the Présent (stoppent) with -ent removed.
The Impératif is the Présent with the pronoun dropped.
